Vj.bar_b_note: The turtle's shell reads as riveted blue-and-gold machinery rather than a natural shell, which pulls it away from the naturalistic finish of the owner bar and Palworld creatures.

Us.bar_b_note: A clear, saturated water-serpent silhouette with fin detail carries it, though the hit react launches the whole body off the ground.

Ow.bar_b_note: A near-black plated body with no rim light merges into its own shadow, and the faint end becomes an armoured ball that does not read as fainted.

Wf.bar_b_note: A's flat plush-white body, black block paws and unchanged hit react, and B's faint end that stands facing the camera, both fall short of the owner's Tanglevolt-class wolf.

Lg.bar_b_note: The naturalistic blue frog's skin and pale belly read strongly at size, though its faint poses barely differ from standing.

Sa.bar_b_note: The dark navy lizard is one low mid-tone with only its yellow eyes separating it, so the silhouette dies at small size.

Db.bar_b_note: A dim brown forest floor with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta ring and slab telegraphs, a player creature too small to find and a HUD covering the left and bottom of every frame sank it, worse in A where trunks and canopy fill i11, i13 and i15.

Xx.bar_b_note: The spotted blue newt-dragon with its orange crest has a creature-collector appeal of its own, though the trainer clips into its body in faint mid and faint end.

Tj.bar_b_note: Glossy, oversaturated electric-blue fur reads as plastic rather than the owner's naturalistic fur, and the body hides the trainer ruler in standing and hit react.

Ph.bar_b_note: The same appealing serpent as Us, with a usable ridden pose, but the airborne hit react and a tiny rider weaken it.

Uw.bar_b_note: A flat, low-detail black dog with yellow bands looks like a placeholder next to the owner bar, and its faint end squashes into a dark slab.

Lq.bar_b_note: The green-and-gold lizard has decent scale detail but low value contrast, and in faint end the trainer stands inside its tail.

Uy.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder with a moss-and-leather palette that fits the Meadows world carries it, even if the face is more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Ry.bar_b_note: A's large wrapped text and clear Craft/Leave hints are readable, but the panels use keyboard-style glyphs rather than controller-first prompts and lack Palworld's HUD polish; B's tiny truncated recipe lines and faint 'Craft: A / Enter' hint sink it.

Zo.bar_b_note: The naturalistic stag, with its antlers and moss mantle, matches the owner bar and reads at size and when ridden.

top_changes.change: Material and value pass on dark or plastic creatures (Sa, Ow, Uw, Tj, Lq): lift albedo values, add rim light and fur or scale breakup, and desaturate Tj's glossy blue so every creature separates from the ground at 30% size.

Stormwood fight presentation (Db): replace flat magenta ring and slab telegraphs with real-object effects (lightning, web, debris) that land with an impact, keep the camera out of trunks and canopy, shrink the HUD footprint, and add the purple storm sky and lightning grade.

Author grounded hit-react and faint animations per creature (the frog and boar faints read as idle, Wf B's faint end stands facing the camera, Us/Ph go airborne on hit), and rebuild the low-detail Uw dog to the naturalistic owner bar.
